selfCheck: Sebelum {shell}: apakah command ini mengubah isi file? Kalau ya, tool-nya salah.

tools.name: read_tool_output
tools.label: Read output
description: Read a truncated tool result by call_id. Use offset for character paging, or line + maxLines for line-based paging.

tools.name: bash
tools.label: Bash
description: Run a shell command for build, test, lint, git, package managers, process/system/disk/network inspection, file management (rename/move/delete), or running scripts.
Do not use {shell} to read or modify file contents; use {read_file}, {create_file}, or {modify_file} instead.
Before calling {shell}, ask: does this command change the contents of a file? If yes, use a file tool.

guard.overrideDescription: Allow redirects, tee, sed -i or Set-Content to write file contents. Default false (blocked).
guard.blockedMessage: BLOCKED: {shell} tidak boleh mengubah isi file. Pakai {create_file} (file baru) atau {modify_file} (file existing). Untuk operasi yang memang disengaja, set {override}=true.

tools.name: python
tools.label: Python
description: Run Python code through stdin, with no shell quoting. For data/spreadsheet processing and verification scripts. Starts in the workspace with a timeout; approved like a shell command.

tools.name: edit
tools.label: Edit
description: Replace one exact string in one existing file.
Use {replace_once} for a single exact replacement; use {modify_file} for multiple hunks, multiple files, add/delete/move, or context-anchored changes.
Matching tolerates CRLF/LF, typographic punctuation, and trailing whitespace. Outside-workspace targets need approval.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.label: Patch
description: Apply a multi-file patch with add/update/delete/move.
Use this for existing-file changes, multiple hunks, multiple files, or context anchors.

Format: `*** Begin Patch`, Add/Update/Delete File markers, `*** End Patch`. Update hunks start with `@@` (optional context anchor); `*** End of File` anchors EOF. Context/removed/added lines use space/-/+; Add lines use +. Optional `*** Move to: path`. Outside paths need approval.

tools.name: write
tools.label: Write
description: Create a new file.
Existing files are rejected unless {override} is true.
Use {modify_file} to modify an existing file.

guard.overrideDescription: Replace an existing file entirely. Default false.
guard.blockedMessage: File already exists. Use {modify_file} to modify it, or pass {override}: true to replace the whole file.

tools.name: read
tools.label: Read
description: Read a text file with line numbers, or an image file as a visual attachment.
Explicit outside paths need approval unless auto mode is on. Use offset and limit for large text files.

tools.name: grep
tools.label: Grep
description: Search text with a regular expression; returns path:line:text.
Explicit outside paths need approval unless auto mode is on.

tools.name: glob
tools.label: Glob
description: Find files by glob pattern; build and dependency directories are skipped.
Explicit outside paths need approval unless auto mode is on.

tools.name: skill
tools.label: Skill
description: Load a skill by name. Empty name lists skills. Without file, returns SKILL.md; with file, reads a file or lists a subfolder inside that skill only.

tools.name: question
tools.label: Question
description: Ask the user one or more blocking questions when the answer changes what you do next and cannot be inferred from the workspace.
Options are optional; omit them for free-form answers.
Do not use this for status updates, explanations, or questions you can answer yourself.
Examples: which database to target; modify the existing file or create a new one; confirm before deleting files; Markdown, JSON, or both.
